executing.description: Indicates whether the pending tasks are currently executing or not.

insert_order.description: The number that represents when the task has been inserted into the task queue.

priority.description:
The priority of the pending task.
The valid priorities in descending priority order are: `IMMEDIATE` > `URGENT` > `HIGH` > `NORMAL` > `LOW` > `LANGUID`.

source.description: A general description of the cluster task that may include a reason and origin.

time_in_queue.description: The time since the task is waiting for being performed.

time_in_queue_millis.description: The time expressed in milliseconds since the task is waiting for being performed.
